The `bw-gopher*` files are copied unchanged from `golang.org/x/image` v0.43.0 (`ccitt/testdata`),
BSD-licensed by The Go Authors. They are a 153 × 55 black-and-white image, encoded as CCITT
Group 4, Group 3 and byte-aligned Group 4, a truncated stream, and the PNG it decodes to. The PDF
scan tests (WIS-645) embed them as fax-encoded page images.
